title: Getting started with brch
text: Use db_label() add label column DB code. Always specify version = "DB07" version = "DB25"; identical codes can different meanings two classifications. Labels come bundled DST tables work offline. Input can contain dots whitespace. Unknown codes return NA warning; missing values stay missing. Keep leading zeroes character codes.
code: df <- data.frame(dbkode = c("011200", "01.49.10", NA)) df |> dplyr::mutate(branche_label = db_label(dbkode, version = "DB07")) #>     dbkode   branche_label #> 1   011200 Dyrkning af ris #> 2 01.49.10        Kenneler #> 3     <NA>            <NA> db_label(c("A", "01", "01.1", "01.11"), version = "DB25") #> [1] "LANDBRUG, JAGT, SKOVBRUG OG FISKERI"                               #> [2] "Plante- og husdyravl, jagt og serviceydelser i forbindelse hermed" #> [3] "Dyrkning af etårige afgrøder"                                      #> [4] "Dyrkning af korn (undtagen ris), bælgfrugter og olieholdige frø"

Use source metadata original industry text time context investigate rows. inspection supports full six-digit codes . convert_db07_to_db25() convert_db25_to_db07() use bundled keys Statistics Denmark (source page updated 26 February 2026), internet connection needed. accept full six-digit codes without dots whitespace: default, code multiple possible destinations returns NA warning. choose DST’s simplified mapping explicitly: simplified matrices specific direction use numbers units, economic activity. approximate used weights distribute turnover. round trip need recover original code. title: Convert industry codes between DB07 and DB25 using Statistics Denmark's keys — convert_db07_to_db25
text: convert_db07_to_db25() converts DB07 DB25; convert_db25_to_db07() converts DB25 DB07. input classification must chosen explicitly: code can occur classifications different meanings. method = "strict", codes multiple destinations return NA warning. method = "simple", destination taken DST's separate simplified conversion matrix chosen direction. reverse conversion invert forward simplified matrix. approximation: DST bases choice numbers units, economic activity. establish correct code every individual business allocate turnover split industries. title: Format DB07 industry codes — format_db07
text: Danish DB07 industry codes (Dansk Branchekode 2007) appear data without dots: "011100" one register, "01.11.00" classification table. format_db07() automatically handles formats, including partially dotted codes whitespace, within vector.
